tools.name: recommend_proxy
tools.description: Pick a published WeProxy product for a job. Uses use-case product lists and the country registry. Does not invent prices or city pools.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List published products that appear in the site catalog, with the same starting price the pricing page shows.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Return package rows for one published product. Prices are formatted the same way as the site. Pass a country code to keep only that location.

tools.name: check_location
tools.description: Say which published products cover a country. City inventory is not in the registry; a city name does not prove a pool.

tools.name: diagnose_proxy_error
tools.description: Look up 407, 502, curl exit codes, browser tunnel errors, or SOCKS reply 0x01-0x08 in the published error guide. Send the code only, never a proxy URL, username, or password.

tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Search published blog posts and SEO landing titles in tr, en, ru, de, or vi.

tools.name: start_free_trial
tools.description: Return the published 1 GB Premium Rotating Residential claim page and its order link. This tool does not describe any other signup credit.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "diagnose_proxy_error" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Look up 407, 502, curl exit codes, browser tunnel errors, or SOCKS reply 0x01-0x08 in the published error guide. Send the code only, never a proxy URL, username…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_guides · Private data: diagnose_proxy_error · Public sink: diagnose_proxy_error.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_guides · Private data: diagnose_proxy_error · Public sink: diagnose_proxy_error

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
